title: Dragon Egg Powers by HexaFoxx
description:
This grants the dragon egg holder a total of 5 effects
Speed 1 Strength 1 Fire resistance 1 Resistance 1 and glowing 1
body:
DragonEggPowers v1.0

DragonEggPowers reimagines the Ender Dragon Egg as a central gameplay element rather than a decorative trophy. Instead of sitting unused, the egg becomes a unique server relic that introduces a dynamic risk-versus-reward system for players.

When a player obtains the Dragon Egg, they receive a set of enhanced abilities designed to improve their effectiveness in combat. These advantages can include increased strength, survivability, or other combat-related benefits depending on your configuration. This makes the egg holder a high-value target and a major presence on the server.

To balance these benefits, the egg also comes with significant drawbacks. The player carrying the egg is continuously tracked, meaning their location is always known or can be easily discovered by others. This prevents long-term hiding, encourages confrontation, and keeps the gameplay active and competitive.

Because of this system, the Dragon Egg naturally becomes a contested objective. Players may form alliances, plan ambushes, or engage in large-scale battles to claim or defend it. The result is a constantly shifting power dynamic where control of the egg can change hands frequently.

DragonEggPowers is designed for servers that want to encourage PvP, player interaction, and emergent gameplay without introducing overly complex mechanics. Server owners can fine-tune the experience to fit their community, ensuring that the egg remains impactful without being unbalanced.
